name: @w6w-apps/onesimpleapi
description: A toolbox of small utility APIs: page metadata, screenshots, PDFs, QR codes, email validation, URL expansion, and currency conversion.

w6w.longDescription:
OneSimpleApi brings a toolbox of small utility operations into a workflow: fetching a web page's metadata, taking a screenshot, generating a PDF or QR code, validating an email address, expanding a shortened URL, and converting between currencies. Each action wraps one focused, well-defined utility endpoint rather than a broad product surface, making this a good fit for the small one-off lookups and conversions that come up inside a larger workflow.

The screenshot, PDF and QR code actions each generate a hosted resource on the vendor's own CDN and are safe to retry — the same inputs reuse a previously generated result rather than creating duplicates. The remaining actions are simple, side-effect-free reads: checking a page's metadata, validating an email format, resolving a shortened link back to its destination, or converting a currency amount at current rates.

This app covers a focused subset of OneSimpleApi's documented endpoints, chosen to match the small-utility use case rather than the vendor's larger, more specialized surfaces like image manipulation or link shortening.
